how_to_apply: Visit the official online application portal at https://careers.iith.ac.in/jobs under Temporary Positions.
Register on the online application portal using a valid and active email ID and mobile number.
Fill in personal information, ensuring the name and date of birth match the 10th Standard/Matriculation Certificate.
Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph and signature in JPG/JPEG format (maximum size 1 MB, taken within the last one month).

Download the automatically generated PDF copy of the application form sent to your registered email ID.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted through the online mode only; offline applications will be summarily rejected. Working hours are 8 hours per day, 6 days a week, with a requirement to work during weekends or holidays when informed by the competent authority. Contractual employees are not eligible for campus residential accommodation by default, though it may be considered on a case-to-case basis depending on essentiality, availability, and payment of license fee. Selected candidates must produce self-attested copies of all certificates along with originals for verification at the time of interview, written test, or skill test. The appointment is purely temporary for 11 months and can be terminated at any time during the contract period with one month's notice from either side. Selected candidates working in any organisation must submit a release or relieving letter in original from their present employer at the time of joining. The selected candidate must possess a valid health insurance policy for the engagement period obtained at their own expense and submit a copy at the time of joining. No Travelling Allowance (TA) or DA shall be paid to candidates for attending the selections.

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Graphic Designer Cum Video Editor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicant must be a citizen of India.

rows.qualification_required: Bachelor’s degree / equivalent qualification with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in Graphic Design, Design / Media Design, Multimedia / Multimedia Design, Visual Communication, Advertising, Public Relations, Media & Communication, Video Production, or other closely related disciplines. Minimum 2.5 years of post qualification professional experience in graphic designing, video editing and multimedia content creation. Proficiency in professional graphic design and video editing software, including relevant tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe InDesign, Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, or equivalent professional software. Demonstrated ability to create high-quality digital and print designs, institutional publications, social media creatives, videos, reels, motion graphics and multimedia content. A strong portfolio demonstrating graphic design, video editing and multimedia work is essential.

faq.question: Q1. What is the IIT Hyderabad Graphic Designer Cum Video Editor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment notification issued by IIT Hyderabad to engage one Graphic Designer Cum Video Editor purely on a contractual basis for an initial period of 11 months.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Graphic Designer Cum Video Editor post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 unreserved (UR) vacancy available under this notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online application is 30-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia, Advertising, Public Relations, or related disciplines, along with a minimum of 2.5 years of post-qualification professional experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for IIT Hyderabad Graphic Designer Cum Video Editor?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years, with relaxations applicable in cases of horizontal reservation as per GoI rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the consolidated remuneration offered for this position?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration ranges from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 50,000/- per month, fixed based on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection mode for IIT Hyderabad Graphic Designer Cum Video Editor?
faq.answer: The selection mode comprises a Written Test, Skill test, or Interview conducted at IIT Hyderabad, Kandi, Sangareddy.

faq.question: Q9. Can offline applications be submitted?
faq.answer: No, candidates are required to submit online applications only. Offline applications will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job position?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on a purely temporary and contractual basis for 11 months, with a possibility of extension subject to satisfactory performance and Institute requirements.
